#Inadactin

Adactin, one of the fastest-growing companies in Australia and the APAC region, thrives on its solutions and services on INNOVATION.  Our vision, combined with our experience in the market, has continuously allowed us to grow our expertise which is visible in our comprehensive portfolio. We innovate, strategize, consult and operate for organizations to achieve their business objectives through an array of our services in Software development, Testing services, Digital transformation, Enterprise solutions, and quality ICT training. Adactin is always committed to delivering with conviction and belief in our people.  Seize the opportunity and advance your career in a dynamic environment to augment your growth and success.
We are looking for a Full-Time ICT Test Engineer to join our team based in Sydney.

Job Salary: $80,000-$100,000

Description:

•	Reviewing software functional designs Providing test estimations
•	Designing and maintaining test plans, test conditions, test specifications, test scripts and procedures
•	Requirements analysis and ensuring full requirement coverage through Test Cases
•	Preparing detailed test documentation and creating automated and manual test scripts
•	Performing functional, business process and regression testing Managing builds to the test environments
•	Co-ordinating User Acceptance Testing and Defect Management Drive continuous improvement of processes

Essential skills and Experience
•	Proven experience with JIRA or HP Quality Center Demonstrated experience in UI / Web application, Mobile App Knowledge of using Continuous Integration
•	Able to manage multiple stakeholders and reporting.
•	Advanced experience testing web-based solutions and large data streams.
•	Demonstrated test case designing and defect analysis skills. Require basic knowledge of Java/.NET/SQL
•	ISEB or ISTQB Testing qualified Integration Testing Using SOAP UI
•	Experience using test automation tools like QTP, Selenium or Coded UI
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work in global teams effectively
•	Agile Experience
•	Certification in Agile preferred
•	Must have experience as a senior test analyst in a very agile environment with a deep understanding of agile development processes like SCRUM & BDD.
•	Take a proactive role in identifying what the feature should be doing and how it should be tested.
•	Experience liaising with SME's, users and product owners on how features should operate and work.
•	Being involved, actively participating and questioning during the sprint.
•	Working closely with the developers in developing high quality test scenarios for Continuous Integration
•	Work closely with Business users and assist with the coordination of UAT during Sprints

Multiple Roles/ Immediate Joining, interested Candidates kindly apply now or email your CV to careers@adactin.com.

On behalf of our client, we are seeking an experienced full-time Account Executive to join a growing APAC Gaming Advertising Solutions team, reporting directly to the Director of Gaming Sales, APAC.

This role will focus on driving advertising revenue across the APAC region, with a primary emphasis on PC and mobile gaming opportunities. This is an ideal role for someone who understands the gaming ecosystem and wants to help game companies connect with highly engaged player communities on Discord. 

What You'll Be Doing 
• Prospect, source, and close new marketing opportunities with PC and mobile game publishers, developers, and media agencies across the APAC region to achieve revenue and account growth goals 
• Build and deepen strategic relationships with key decision makers across APAC, including advertisers, agencies, and ecosystem partners, while navigating regional business practices and cross border commercial dynamics 
• Identify and unlock mobile first opportunities by understanding client growth objectives, launch strategies, user acquisition priorities, and community engagement goals 
• Create compelling sales presentations and proposals using internal and external data, with clear relevance to localized APAC gaming audiences and advertiser needs 
• Become an expert in Discord’s advertising solutions and tailor recommendations to suit a wide range of client objectives across PC and mobile gaming, including performance, launch, engagement, and community led campaigns 
• Partner closely with internal cross functional teams including account management, marketing, measurement, product, and operations to deliver strong client outcomes and long term growth 
• Represent Discord credibly in the market through client meetings, industry events, and partner discussions across Southeast Asia, Greater China, and other relevant APAC markets 

What you should have 
• 5+ years of direct experience in digital advertising, ad sales, mobile marketing, media, or business development within the PC and mobile gaming ecosystem 
• Strong experience working with game publishers, developers, or agencies across the APAC Region, with a solid understanding of the regional market landscape and commercial decision making 
• Proven track record of delivering against revenue targets, building pipeline, and closing strategic accounts in a fast moving environment 
• Strong knowledge of the gaming advertising ecosystem, including user acquisition, performance marketing, brand campaigns, measurement, and ad tech 
• Ability to build trust with senior stakeholders and translate client objectives into clear commercial opportunities

result.description:
Data Engineer
Trading under Publicis Communications
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Data Engineer (also known as BI Developer, Quantitative Data Engineer, Search Engineer, Technical Architect, Big Data Analyst, Solutions Architect, Data Warehouse Engineer, Data Science Software Engineer, ETL Developer)
The role of the Data Engineer is to work alongside solution architects, data analysts & data scientists to deliver various aspects of the marketing technology ecosystem. The Data Engineer is responsible for engaging machine learning techniques to create and sustain structures that allow for the analysis of data whilst remaining familiar with dominant programming and deployment strategies. Data engineering experience is critical, as well as knowledge of data warehousing, ETL strategies and tools, and BI tools. Experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP is beneficial.
Data Engineer Responsibilities:
•	Anticipating and mitigating delivery risks and following issues through to closure
•	Advocating for data management methodologies and processes on all projects
•	Assuming responsibility for data quality, ensuring that testing is carried out in a rigorous fashion resulting in production of high-quality deliverables
•	Adopting a flexible approach to completing workload to ensuring timely delivery and reinforcing commitment to delivery and quality within the technical team, including offshore development centres 
•	Creating and managing the relevant technical design documentation and ensures the documents completeness and accuracy
•	Ensuring that data architecture is implemented according to the design 
•	Ensuring solutions delivered use existing standards and frameworks
•	Contributing to business development efforts through accurate project scoping, estimating and attending sales calls when required
•	Collaborating with globally dispersed teams on international projects.  This includes co-ordinating build activities with offshore development centres in India and Asia Pacific
•	Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.
Data Engineer Requirements:
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Proven experience as a data engineer, software developer, or similar.
•	Expert proficiency in Python, C++, Java, R, and SQL.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Works well independently but also a team player and able to work collaboratively
•	Scrupulous approach to duties.
•	Strong presentation and written communication skills, with ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and clients
•	Experience developing data processing and analytics solutions in a digital agency or IT consultancy as part of a multi-disciplinary team
